# Magic Mirror Rental Services

> Magic Mirror photo booth rentals for weddings, corporate events, birthdays, baby showers and special occasions across the Greater Boston Area, Massachusetts. Established in 2019.

The Magic Mirror is a full-length, touch-screen mirror photo booth. Guests see themselves as photos are taken, pose with props and attendant guidance, and get instant 4x6 prints plus MMS and email sharing. Every event has two on-site attendants, a professional DSLR camera and lighting, and props.

## Packages

- Bronze, $650: 3 hours, unlimited sessions with 2 prints per session, template overlay design (over 500 available), private online gallery.
- Silver, $850: 4 hours, unlimited sessions and prints, 1 custom overlay design, private online gallery, USB drive of all photos.
- Gold, $1100: 5 hours, unlimited sessions and prints, 3 custom overlay designs, professional backdrop, private online gallery, USB drive of all photos.

Events inside the City of Boston have no travel fee; events outside Boston include a travel fee. A $250 non-refundable deposit is required, with the balance due 14 days before the event. Book at least 30 days ahead when possible.
